segments.name: Insurance & Services
segments.description: Underwrites primary insurance globally for clients and partners, including accident & health, property & casualty and specialty lines.
segments.evidence: In our Insurance & Services segment, we underwrite primary insurance in several sectors globally.

segments.name: Reinsurance
segments.description: Provides treaty and facultative reinsurance products to insurance and reinsurance companies, government entities and other risk bearing vehicles.
segments.evidence: In our Reinsurance segment, we provide reinsurance products to insurance and reinsurance companies, government entities, and other risk bearing vehicles.

revenueModel.text: SiriusPoint earns underwriting premium from insurance and reinsurance clients, service fee income from consolidated MGAs, and investment results.
revenueModel.evidence: Our business model remains diversified as we continue to benefit from the three sources of earnings: (i) underwriting results; (ii) services fee income from the MGAs we consolidate; and (iii) investment results.

changes.text: In 2025, SiriusPoint sold ArmadaCorp Capital, a previously consolidated MGA.
changes.evidence: During 2025, we sold ArmadaCorp Capital, LLC ("Armada"), which was a consolidated MGA that we previously owned 100% of, and recognized a gain of $222.4 million as a result.

dropped: change not grounded: In 2024, the MGA Arcadian was deconsolidated.
